In each of the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements. 

**Statements:**

I. No cups are plate.

II. All plates are spoons.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cups are spoons.

II. Some spoons are plates.

III. Some plates are spoons.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b9d84b762ee46b6a8b7ef265599b044abdfb7e1a2827715e3d387089b1b57b6.png]

I. Some cups are spoons → False (As there is no direct relation given between cup and spoon so it will not follow.)

II. Some spoons are plates → True (As all plates are spoons, some spoons will definitely be the plates, so it will follow)

III. Some plates are spoons → True (As all plates are spoons given in statements, some plates are definitely spoons, so it will follow)

Hence, **only conclusion II and III follow.**

questions.question: BIT is also known as _____.
questions.solution: A bit, short for binary digit, is the smallest unit of data in a computer. A bit has a single binary value, either 0 or 1. questions.question: Which of the following is a genetic disease?
questions.solution: People who inherit an unbalanced translocation involving chromosome 21 may have extra genetic material from chromosome 21, which causes Down syndrome. questions.question: Who among the following said that 'Democracy is the government of the people, for the people and by the people'?

questions.question: What is meant by 'defection'?
questions.solution: In politics, a defector is a person who gives up allegiance to one state in exchange for allegiance to another, in a way which is considered illegitimate by the first state. More broadly, it involves abandoning a person, cause, or doctrine to which one is bound by some tie, as of allegiance or duty. This term is also applied, often pejoratively, to anyone who switches loyalty to another religion, sports team, political party, or other rival faction. In that sense, the defector is often considered a traitor by their original side. The physical act of defection is usually in a manner which violates the laws of the nation or political entity from which the person is seeking to depart.

questions.question: How many types of emergencies can be proclaimed in India?

questions.question: What is the full form of GNI?

Comparing the GNI and GDP shows whether a nation's resources are put to capital creation or declining toward abroad. Gross national income is the basis of calculation of the largest part of contributions to the budget of the European Union.

questions.question: Ox-bow lakes are formed when river is ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e., __**At very low gradient.**__

 
• At a very low gradient of the river, an oxbow lake, which is a U shaped body of water, that forms when a wide meander from the main stem of a river is cut off, creating a free-standing body of water.
 
• This land form is so named for its distinctive curved shape, resembling the bow pin of an oxbow.

There are three stages of the river:

 
• Youthful stage

 
 
• A river with a steep gradient that has very few tributaries and flows quickly.
 
• Its channels erode deeper rather than wider.
 
• Its velocity is fast and strong
 
• Rapids may be present due to the water velocity and the presence of boulders in the channel
 
• waterfalls are also a feature of the young river.
 
• Shallow V-shaped valleys are present.
 
 
 
• Mature stage:
 
 
• The mature river channel is U-shaped, but not deeper and wider than the channel of the older river.
 
• Rapids are absent in this stage so the river does not form a V-shaped channel.
 
• Deep V-shaped valleys are present.
 
 
 
• Old stage
 
 
• When the river reaches the end of its journey, it is called an old river.
 
• The end of the river is called the mouth and at the mouth, there is often a river delta.
 
 
 
• Gorge is a narrow valley with steep rocky walls on both sides and a river usually flowing in between.

questions.question: A boy added all natural numbers from 1 to 12, however he added one number twice due to which the sum becomes 80. What is the number which he added twice?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Sum of first 12 **natural numbers** = [12 × (12 + 1)] ÷ 2

Actual Sum = 6 × 13 = 78

Given total sum after adding a **number twice** = 80

**Repeated number** = New Sum − Actual Sum = 80 − 78 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Range of numbers = 1 to 12

Sum obtained = 80

**Formula used:**

Sum of first **n natural numbers** = n(n + 1) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22409391616028bfb95e4d42492769c4c0616dfde85f13aa8b8983d649968340.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Actual sum of numbers from 1 to 12 = [12 × (12 + 1)] ÷ 2

⇒ Sum = [12 × 13] ÷ 2 = 6 × 13 = 78

⇒ Let the **repeated number** be x.

⇒ Sum including the repeated number = 78 + x

⇒ 78 + x = 80

⇒ x = 80 − 78

⇒ x = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Sum of Squares of first n Natural Numbers

The formula to calculate the sum of squares is [n(n + 1)(2n + 1)] ÷ 6.

Sum of Cubes of first n Natural Numbers

The formula to calculate the sum of cubes is [n(n + 1) ÷ 2]².

Sum of first n Even/Odd Numbers

Sum of first n **even numbers** is n(n + 1), and sum of first n **odd numbers** is n².</p

**Below are three alternatives which may be used to improve the sentence by replacing the words given in the brackets. You may choose option 1, 2 or 3. In case no improvement is needed, choose 4.**

I met the two boys, (whom I believe are) twins.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"who"** is correctly used as a relative pronoun in this sentence. It introduces a relative clause **("who I believe are twins")** that provides more information about the antecedent, which in this case is "the two boys."
 
• Relative pronouns such as** "who"** relate to the noun they modify and act within their clause as a subject or object. In this sentence, "who" serves as the subject of the verb "are," correctly linking the verb to the two boys implied by **"who."**
 
• **Let's break the sentence: **
 
 
• I met the two boys, who are twins, I believe it.
 
 
 
• The choice of **"who" **over "whom" is grounded in the function of "who" within the clause. Since it acts as the subject of the verb "are," "who" is the appropriate choice. "Whom" would be used if the relative pronoun were the object of the clause or of a preposition.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"who I believe are"**

**Corrected sentence is: ***I met the two boys, who I believe are twins.*
